title: Paytable — config/paytable.json
description: Complete pay definition of the game. All pays are x-bet with at most two decimals, stored as integer hundredths of a bet in payX100 (2.5x -> 250). winMinor = (betMinor * payX100) // 100 (floor); the math model and simulator MUST apply the identical integer rule.

evaluationMode.description: Win-evaluation archetype this paytable is written for. Must match winEvaluation.mode in game-config.json. scatter_pays = pays-anywhere count thresholds (v1.0.1 widening).

directionRule.description: Where matched runs may start/extend: leftmost-consecutive (left_to_right), rightmost, both directions, or free adjacency (cluster/any-adjacent games).

entries.description: Line/ways pay entries — one per paying symbol.

symbolId.description: Paying symbol; must exist in config/symbols.json.

ofAKindPays.description: Map from match length/count threshold ("3".."30", as strings) to pay in payX100 units. For lines/ways: exact of-a-kind counts (3..8). For scatter_pays: ascending band thresholds (e.g. "8", "10", "12" — a count pays the highest threshold <= count). Lengths not listed pay nothing.

^([3-9]|[12][0-9]|30)$.description: Pay for this of-a-kind count (lines/ways) or band threshold (scatter_pays), in integer hundredths of a bet.

scatterPays.description: Optional pay-anywhere scatter pays awarded in addition to (or instead of) feature triggers.

pays.description: Map from scatter count on the grid ("2".."8", as strings) to pay in payX100 units.

^[2-8]$.description: Total scatter pay for this count, in integer hundredths of a bet.

clusterPays.description: Cluster pay bands — required by the config validator when evaluationMode is "cluster", forbidden otherwise.

symbolId.description: Paying symbol; must exist in config/symbols.json.

sizeBands.description: Non-overlapping, ascending cluster-size bands (config validator checks ordering).

minSize.description: Smallest cluster size (inclusive) of this band.

maxSize.description: Largest cluster size (inclusive) of this band; must be >= minSize.

payX100.description: Pay for any cluster whose size falls in this band, in integer hundredths of a bet.

wildSubstitutionNote.description: Optional human-readable clarification of wild substitution edge cases (e.g. pure-wild line pays as highest substituted symbol).

allOf.$comment: clusterPays is only meaningful for cluster evaluation. Validation message: 'clusterPays requires evaluationMode "cluster".'
any_adjacent direction only applies to positionless evaluation. Validation message: 'directionRule "any_adjacent" requires evaluationMode "cluster" or "scatter_pays".'

payX100.description: Pay as integer hundredths of a bet (x-bet * 100), e.g. 2.5x -> 250. Upper bound = 250000x max-win ceiling * 100.

minorUnits.description: Monetary amount in integer minor units (e.g. cents). Never a binary float.

tierId.description: Canonical scatter feature tier id (3 / 4 / 5+ scatters).

symbolId.description: Canonical symbol id, e.g. WILD, SCATTER, H1, L3, JP_GRAND.

projectSlug.description: Kebab-case project slug used for games/<slug>/.
